notes: Go ▸ Clean Up Unused Files… (or right-click a folder) lists the pictures, PDFs and other attachments nothing links to, and moves the ones you tick to the Trash; files whose name still turns up somewhere are listed separately and left unticked. Right-click ▸ Remove… sends a file or folder to the Trash, and if that broke links, a Links You Broke panel lists them and keeps checking as you fix them. Go ▸ Find Broken Links does the same for the whole folder. View ▸ Show Hidden Files shows dot-files; .gitbook, .github and .vitepress always show. Markdoc files (.markdoc, .mdoc) open too.
